title: Visit continuity word rules
description: clinical-content/rules/visit-continuity.json: the words that decide whether today's complaint is the same problem as the last visit (stop words, body-region map, suffix trimming, minimum word length). A shared clinical rule file read by the web (lib/triage-engine/src/visit-continuity.ts) and iOS (VisitContinuity.swift through SharedClinicalContent); the matching logic stays twinned. Registered as visit-continuity.

minWordLength.description: A word shorter than this (in letters) is not a content word, unless it is a region word.

stopWords.description: Lower-case words that say nothing about which problem it is.

regions.description: Region token ("region-abdomen") -> the lower-case words for that body region, so a reworded complaint about the same area is not a new problem. A word belongs to one region only.

suffixRules.description: Trim the first suffix (in this order) a word ends with, unless it ends with keepEnding, when at least minStemLength letters remain.
